description: Get a performance report for Reddit ads. Spend values are in microcurrency (divide by 1,000,000 for dollars).

account_id.description: Ad account ID. Uses default if not provided.

breakdowns.description: Breakdown dimensions: ad_id, campaign_id, ad_group_id, date, country, region, community, placement, device_os.

end_date.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

fields.description: Metric fields. Defaults to impressions, clicks, spend, ctr, cpc, ecpm. Available: impressions, reach, clicks, spend, ecpm, ctr, cpc, video_watched_25/50/75/100_percent, conversion_purchase_clicks, etc.

start_date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 7 days ago.

name: reddit_ads_get_performance_report
